about: Cases where the Rust engine deliberately differs from the recorded 3.6 behaviour. The oracle test fails if a case here stops differing, or differs in another way.

divergences.reason: strict-end: 3.6 accepted one trailing line break because the .NET '$' anchor matches before it. An identifier with a line break must not reach a command line.
strict-end: same as above, at the 200-character limit.
strict-end: 3.6 built a WinGet command line containing the line break.
strict-end: an exported identifier with a line break is rejected like any other invalid identifier.
strict-end: a saved selection cannot carry a key with a line break.
strict-end: 3.6 accepted a registry path ending in a line break as a cleanup candidate.
